description.en: Windows-only always-on-top overlay fed by a Cordis bundle: session state (running, waiting for approval, finished, error) travels over a named pipe to a native Go executable, which draws a layered window with a tray icon so sessions from DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, OpenCode and Antigravity stay visible at once. Clicking a row focuses the terminal it belongs to. Reporting is fire-and-forget, so a missing or stopped overlay never blocks the host. The overlay also runs standalone with terminal hooks instead of the bundle.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的置顶浮窗，由 Cordis bundle 上报会话状态：运行中、等待审批、已完成、出错四类状态经命名管道送到原生 Go 程序，由它绘制分层窗口并附带托盘图标，把 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code、OpenCode、Antigravity 的会话同时列出来；点击某一行会切到对应终端。上报是发后即忘的，浮窗没装或没运行时不会阻塞宿主。不使用 bundle 时也可通过终端钩子独立运行。
